verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a documented Next.js framework guide, SQLite compatibility, and SDKs for TypeScript, Python, Rust, and Go, which suggests SQLite-oriented tooling could connect. No evidence mentions Prisma, Drizzle, Django, or Rails. Community reports of compatibility gaps (missing savepoints; Turso-specific schema features breaking standard SQLite tooling) cast doubt on 'out of the box' ORM behavior. Missing for 10: documented Prisma/Drizzle/Django/Rails integration guides, evidence of ORM migration support, hands-on corroboration of ORM compatibility.
